measurement: Each API child, generator+SDK and Centrifugo process is separate, on the same Windows host; PG 18.6 in Docker Desktop Linux using a new disk volume per run, fsync/synchronous_commit/full_page_writes remain on. Not independent hardware or production capacity.
comparability: A1/B1/C1/A2/D1/A3/D2 staged and interleaved. Same input, body, subjects and worker counts. Topic UUIDs/routing collisions differ. 3s warmup and 12s launch window, no retries. Profiling disabled for comparisons.
diagnostic_run: diagnostic2 used memory storage and profiling; all phases retained privately. Its teardown failed because deferred cancellation killed the API before testing.Cleanup; corrected with ordered Cleanup before A1. Not included in comparisons. Windows pprof samples include blocked syscall/control-pipe stacks, so percentages are not treated as OS CPU usage.
